description: Conduit — SEC EDGAR Filings & Fundamentals: Look up a US public company's identity from SEC EDGAR: CIK, legal name, exchange, SIC industry, state of incorporation, fiscal year end.
name: conduit_lookup_company

description: Conduit — SEC EDGAR Filings & Fundamentals: Latest 10-K XBRL facts for a company: revenue, profits, EPS, assets, liabilities, equity, cash, debt, cash flows. Values as reported (USD unless noted).
name: conduit_get_company_facts

description: Conduit — SEC EDGAR Filings & Fundamentals: Recent SEC filings for a company, filterable by form type (10-K, 10-Q, 8-K, 4, ...). Returns filing dates, descriptions and EDGAR archive URLs.

form.description: SEC form filter, e.g. 10-K. Omit for all forms.

name: conduit_list_filings

description: Conduit — SEC EDGAR Filings & Fundamentals: Key financial ratios computed from the latest 10-K XBRL: gross/operating/net margins, ROE, ROA, debt-to-equity, free cash flow. Null where inputs are missing.
name: conduit_get_financial_ratios

description: Conduit — SEC EDGAR Filings & Fundamentals: Full-text search across SEC filings (risk factors, MD&A, disclosures). Falls back to recent-filing listing if the search index is unreachable.

ticker.description: Restrict to a company's ticker, e.g. AAPL

name: conduit_search_filings

description: Conduit — SEC EDGAR Filings & Fundamentals: Full company identity from SEC EDGAR: addresses, phone, website, filer category, former names, all tickers/exchanges.
name: conduit_get_company_profile

description: Conduit — SEC EDGAR Filings & Fundamentals: Fuzzy company-name search across all SEC filers: returns matching tickers, CIKs and exchanges.

query.description: Name or ticker fragment, e.g. 'apple' or 'berkshire'

name: conduit_get_ticker_search

description: Conduit — SEC EDGAR Filings & Fundamentals: Full time series for one XBRL concept (any taxonomy/tag), e.g. us-gaap:Revenues. Filter by 10-K or 10-Q.
name: conduit_get_company_concept

description: Conduit — SEC EDGAR Filings & Fundamentals: Quarterly trend for a key metric (revenue, net_income, eps_diluted, ...) from 10-Q filings.

metric.description: One of: revenue, gross_profit, operating_income, net_income, eps_diluted, total_assets, total_liabilities, total_equity, cash, long_term_debt, operating_cash_flow, capex

name: conduit_get_quarterly_trend

description: Conduit — SEC EDGAR Filings & Fundamentals: Year-over-year growth rates for revenue, net income, diluted EPS and total assets from 10-K history.
name: conduit_get_annual_growth

description: Conduit — SEC EDGAR Filings & Fundamentals: Structured income statement, balance sheet or cash-flow statement; annual or quarterly, multiple periods.
name: conduit_get_financial_statement

description: Conduit — SEC EDGAR Filings & Fundamentals: Revenue (or another metric) broken down by business segment, product line, or geography — parsed from the latest 10-K's XBRL instance (companyfacts carries no segment dimensions).
name: conduit_get_segment_data

description: Conduit — SEC EDGAR Filings & Fundamentals: Debt components for the latest 10-K period: short-term borrowings, current debt, long-term debt.
name: conduit_get_debt_breakdown

description: Conduit — SEC EDGAR Filings & Fundamentals: Shares outstanding history (dei:EntityCommonStockSharesOutstanding), latest first.
name: conduit_get_shares_outstanding

description: Conduit — SEC EDGAR Filings & Fundamentals: Annual cash dividends paid (XBRL cash-flow tags), newest first. Negative = cash outflow.
name: conduit_get_dividend_payments

description: Conduit — SEC EDGAR Filings & Fundamentals: Rank a company against ALL SEC filers for one metric and calendar period (frames API). Uses the company's own current XBRL tag unless overridden.

metric.description: Metric to rank (revenue, gross_profit, operating_income, net_income, eps_diluted, total_assets, total_liabilities, total_equity, cash, long_term_debt, operating_cash_flow, capex); default revenue

period.description: CY2024 or CY2024Q4; omit for latest available year

tag.description: Explicit XBRL tag override, e.g. Revenues

name: conduit_get_peer_comparison

description: Conduit — SEC EDGAR Filings & Fundamentals: Side-by-side key facts (revenue, net income, EPS, assets, equity) for up to 5 tickers, latest 10-K each.
name: conduit_compare_companies

description: Conduit — SEC EDGAR Filings & Fundamentals: List every document inside one filing (parsed from the filing's EDGAR index page).
name: conduit_get_filing_documents

description: Conduit — SEC EDGAR Filings & Fundamentals: Cleaned text excerpt from a filing's primary document (head-only, capped).

document.description: Document filename or SEC URL; omit for the primary document

name: conduit_get_filing_text

description: Conduit — SEC EDGAR Filings & Fundamentals: Recent 8-K filings with their Item headings extracted from the document text (best-effort).
name: conduit_get_8k_summary

description: Conduit — SEC EDGAR Filings & Fundamentals: Insider ownership filings (Forms 3/4/5) with reporting-owner names parsed best-effort.
name: conduit_get_insider_filings

description: Conduit — SEC EDGAR Filings & Fundamentals: Filing counts by SEC form and by year across the company's full filing history.
name: conduit_get_filing_counts

description: Conduit — SEC EDGAR Filings & Fundamentals: Amended filings (/A forms: 10-K/A, 10-Q/A, 8-K/A, ...) in reverse chronological order.
name: conduit_get_filing_amendments

description: Conduit — SEC EDGAR Filings & Fundamentals: Key XBRL facts from the latest 10-Q: revenue, profits, EPS, assets, cash, debt.
name: conduit_get_10q_facts
